provenance: Original, explicitly selected template lessons authored for SynapticGenesis. Examples and targets are deterministic expansions of the listed vocabulary and literal templates; no pretrained weights or teacher distributions are imported.

templates.two_facts: The {object} is in the {location}. The {other} is in the {alternative}.
templates.changed_fact: The {object} is in the {alternative}. Now the {object} is in the {location}.

split.method: Hold out ordered object pairs: cyclic distance 1 is development; distance 2 is test; distances 3,4,5 are training. Both answer directions, location choices and skills stay in the same split. Only two_facts appears in evaluation because it depends on an object-pair relation. Single/changed facts teach prerequisite forms using training objects.

limits: A narrow controlled reading-and-response curriculum, not a general language corpus or evidence of human developmental ages. Evaluation uses held-out object combinations within familiar templates and vocabulary; unseen syntax and real-world competence are not tested.
